scope: All 467 candidates from both provider modules manually inspected. Name/example/configuration/translator metadata preserved; fixed labels/descriptions/errors translated.

rows.original: Header “{name}” looks like a credential. Use the headers helper script so the secret isn’t stored in the config file.
rows.translation: 请求头“{name}”看起来包含凭据。请使用请求头助手脚本，避免将密钥存入配置文件。

rows.original: Header “{name}” looks like a credential. Use the credential helper script (it can print headers) so the secret isn’t stored in the config file.
rows.translation: 请求头“{name}”看起来包含凭据。请使用凭据助手脚本（可输出请求头），避免将密钥存入配置文件。
助手脚本缓存 TTL

rows.original: Helper output is cached for this many seconds; once it expires the helper re-runs without a relaunch (before the next turn when set above 120).
rows.translation: 助手输出缓存的秒数；到期后无需重启即可重新运行助手（大于 120 时，在下一轮开始前运行）。
凭据助手超时

rows.original: Maximum wait for the helper executable to finish. Raise this if the helper opens a browser for interactive sign-in.
rows.translation: 等待助手程序完成的最长时间。如果助手会打开浏览器进行交互式登录，可增大此值。

rows.original: AWS region for the Bedrock runtime endpoint.
rows.translation: Bedrock 运行时端点所在的 AWS 区域。
Bedrock 基础 URL
AWS Bearer 令牌

rows.original: Passed to the helper script as AWS_PROFILE.
rows.translation: 以 AWS_PROFILE 传给助手脚本。

rows.original: Directory holding the AWS config and credentials files. Passed to the helper script as AWS_CONFIG_FILE and AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE.
rows.translation: 存放 AWS 配置和凭据文件的目录。以 AWS_CONFIG_FILE 和 AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE 传给助手脚本。

rows.original: Absolute path to the aws executable, shared with the Bedrock profile setting. Not passed to the helper script.
rows.translation: aws 程序的绝对路径，与 Bedrock 配置项共用，不会传给助手脚本。

rows.original: Passed to the helper script as AWS_REGION.
rows.translation: 以 AWS_REGION 传给助手脚本。
助手脚本（Windows）

rows.original: Absolute path of the helper executable on Windows devices, used there instead of Helper script. Leave unset to use Helper script on every operating system.
rows.translation: Windows 设备上助手程序的绝对路径，用于替代“助手脚本”。留空则所有操作系统均使用“助手脚本”。
助手脚本参数

rows.original: Arguments passed to the helper script, one per entry, in order. Leave unset to run it with none.
rows.translation: 按顺序传给助手脚本的参数，每项一个。留空则不传参数。

rows.original: No API resource scope set. On IdPs where the requested scopes decide the access-token audience (e.g. Entra ID), this yields a token for the IdP’s own APIs, not your gateway or proxy. Add its API scope (Entra: api://APP_ID/.default). Ignore this if your IdP sets the token audience out-of-band (Keycloak audience mapper, Auth0 default audience, Okta custom-AS audience).
rows.translation: 未设置 API 资源作用域。对于由请求作用域决定访问令牌受众的 IdP（如 Entra ID），生成的令牌用于 IdP 自身的 API，而非网关或代理。请添加对应的 API 作用域（Entra：api://APP_ID/.default）。若 IdP 通过其他方式设置令牌受众（Keycloak 受众映射器、Auth0 默认受众、Okta 自定义授权服务器受众），可忽略此提示。
网关 SSO 身份提供商（OIDC）
网关管理的 Claude Code

rows.original: When true, sessions for users signed in through the gateway’s own sign-in run Claude Code in its gateway mode. Gateway provider only. Default false.
rows.translation: 开启后，通过网关自身登录流程登录的用户，其会话会以网关模式运行 Claude Code。仅适用于 Gateway 提供商，默认关闭。
AWS SSO 起始 URL

rows.original: Enables in-app AWS sign-in (no AWS CLI needed). Set with the three SSO fields below.
rows.translation: 启用应用内 AWS 登录，无需 AWS CLI。请同时设置下方三个 SSO 字段。
AWS SSO 区域
IAM Identity Center 的主区域。
AWS SSO 账户 ID

rows.original: 12-digit AWS account ID assigned to users in IAM Identity Center.
rows.translation: IAM Identity Center 为用户分配的 12 位 AWS 账户 ID。

rows.original: IAM Identity Center permission-set name granting bedrock:InvokeModel* on the account above.
rows.translation: 在上述账户中授予 bedrock:InvokeModel* 权限的 IAM Identity Center 权限集名称。
Bedrock 服务层级
（按需）

rows.original: Sent as the X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier header. Leave unset for on-demand.
rows.translation: 作为 X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier 请求头发送。留空则使用按需服务。

rows.original: IAM role for the Microsoft 365 add-in
rows.translation: Microsoft 365 加载项的 IAM 角色

rows.original: Role the Microsoft 365 add-in assumes with the user’s Entra ID token (STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity). Not read by Claude Desktop.
rows.translation: Microsoft 365 加载项通过用户的 Entra ID 令牌承担的角色（STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity）。Claude Desktop 不读取此项。
Vertex OAuth 客户端 ID

rows.original: Desktop-app OAuth client ID. Enables Sign in with Google instead of a credentials file.
rows.translation: 桌面应用的 OAuth 客户端 ID。启用 Google 登录，替代凭据文件。
Vertex OAuth 客户端密钥

rows.original: Secret for the Desktop-app OAuth client above. Google classifies installed-app client secrets as non-confidential, so this may be set from hosted config.
rows.translation: 上述桌面应用 OAuth 客户端的密钥。Google 将已安装应用的客户端密钥视为非机密信息，因此可由托管配置设置。
Vertex OAuth 作用域

rows.original: Override the Google OAuth scopes (space-separated). Leave blank for the default.
rows.translation: 覆盖 Google OAuth 作用域，以空格分隔。留空使用默认值。
员工身份联合（STS）
员工身份联合的身份提供商（OIDC）
GCP 凭据文件路径

rows.original: Absolute path to service-account JSON. Leave blank to fall back to ADC.
rows.translation: 服务账户 JSON 文件的绝对路径。留空则回退到 ADC。
GCP 项目 ID
GCP 区域

rows.original: GCP region where your Vertex AI Claude models are deployed.
rows.translation: 部署 Vertex AI Claude 模型的 GCP 区域。
Vertex AI 基础 URL
如果使用 PSC，填写其端点。

rows.original: Azure AI Foundry resource name used to construct the endpoint URL.
rows.translation: 用于构造端点 URL 的 Azure AI Foundry 资源名称。
Azure AI Foundry 基础 URL

rows.original: Full base URL for a gateway or proxy in front of Foundry, path included (replaces https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic).
rows.translation: Foundry 前方网关或代理的完整基础 URL，包含路径（替代 https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic）。
交互式登录
云提供商配置
员工身份联合
身份提供商登录（OIDC）
自托管执行
自托管 Bearer 令牌

rows.original: Static token sent as Authorization: Bearer. Prefer a helper script or sign-in.
rows.translation: 作为 Authorization: Bearer 发送的静态令牌。建议使用助手脚本或登录流程。
自托管执行 URL

rows.original: HTTPS endpoint of the self-hosted session host (beta).
rows.translation: 自托管会话主机的 HTTPS 端点（测试版）。

rows.original: Shown in the skill list and used to run the skill. It replaces any skill a user added with the same name.
rows.translation: 显示在技能列表中，并用于运行技能。将替换用户添加的同名技能。

rows.original: Shown under the name in the skill list. Claude reads it to decide when to use the skill.
rows.translation: 显示在技能列表的名称下方。Claude 据此决定何时使用该技能。

rows.original: Where the add-in downloads the skill: a zip or a SKILL.md file. A pre-signed storage URL works.
rows.translation: 加载项下载技能的位置：ZIP 或 SKILL.md 文件。支持预签名存储 URL。

rows.original: The add-in refuses a download with any other SHA-256, so a file that changed after you added it can’t install. Recommended.
rows.translation: 若下载文件的 SHA-256 不同，加载项会拒绝下载，因此添加后发生变化的文件无法安装。建议设置。
技能包

rows.original: Skills the Microsoft 365 add-in installs for every user.
rows.translation: Microsoft 365 加载项为每位用户安装的技能。
Claude Code 插件
认证

rows.original: How fetches authenticate: anonymously, with the user’s git credentials, via a helper executable, or as the app does to its gateway or bootstrap server (url).
rows.translation: 获取内容时的认证方式：匿名、用户的 Git 凭据、助手程序，或应用访问网关或引导服务器时使用的方式（url）。

rows.original: Executable that prints an access token for this marketplace.
rows.translation: 输出此市场访问令牌的程序。
版本引用
分支、标签或提交 SHA
子路径
清单 SHA-256
marketplace.json 的 64 位十六进制 SHA-256

rows.original: SHA-256 of the exact marketplace.json to accept. Without it auto_install and required act as available; a served manifest with any other digest is refused.
rows.translation: 允许接收的 marketplace.json 文件的精确 SHA-256。未设置时，auto_install 和 required 均按 available 处理；提供的清单摘要不符时会被拒绝。
市场 URL

rows.original: Where the marketplace is fetched from: a GitHub repository (set repo), any Git remote (set url), or a hosted marketplace.json file (set url).
rows.translation: 获取市场的位置：GitHub 仓库（设置 repo）、任意 Git 远程仓库（设置 url），或托管的 marketplace.json 文件（设置 url）。

rows.original: HTTPS Git remote of the marketplace repository (git), or direct HTTPS URL of a hosted marketplace.json file (url).
rows.translation: 市场仓库的 HTTPS Git 远程地址（git），或托管 marketplace.json 文件的直接 HTTPS URL（url）。

rows.original: GitHub repository in owner/repo form. Case-insensitive.
rows.translation: 以 owner/repo 格式填写 GitHub 仓库，不区分大小写。
组织插件端点

rows.original: Automatic installation needs {source, select, url {a Manifest SHA-256} other {a full 40-character commit SHA in Ref}}. Without one this marketplace is treated as available: it is listed, but this setting installs nothing.
rows.translation: 自动安装需要{source, select, url {清单 SHA-256} other {“版本引用”中的完整 40 位提交 SHA}}。未设置时，此市场按可用处理：会显示在列表中，但此设置不会安装任何内容。
GitHub 仓库

rows.original: HTTPS address each published item is POSTed to, with no query or fragment. Plain http on a loopback host is taken only from device management or the local file.
rows.translation: 每个发布项通过 POST 发送到的 HTTPS 地址，不得包含查询或片段。回环主机的普通 http 地址仅接受设备管理或本地文件配置。

rows.original: What each request carries: nothing, a helper executable’s output as Authorization, or the credential the app already sends its gateway or bootstrap server.
rows.translation: 每个请求携带的内容：无认证信息、作为 Authorization 的助手程序输出，或应用已发送给网关或引导服务器的凭据。
组织分享端点

rows.original: HTTPS endpoint that receives the skills and plugins users publish to the organization. When set, users get a Publish to organization action.
rows.translation: 接收用户向组织发布的技能和插件的 HTTPS 端点。设置后，用户可执行“发布到组织”。

rows.original: Allow users to add plugin marketplaces. When off, marketplaces your organization did not provision are hidden and the app’s sessions do not load their plugins.
rows.translation: 允许用户添加插件市场。关闭后，隐藏组织未提供的市场，应用会话也不会加载这些市场的插件。
OpenTelemetry 导出协议

rows.original: Transport protocol for the OpenTelemetry exporters.
rows.translation: OpenTelemetry 导出器的传输协议。

rows.original: Chats and Cowork tasks on Windows or behind an HTTP proxy, and the app’s own events, export over OTLP/HTTP to this same endpoint. Choose grpc only if the collector also accepts OTLP/HTTP there.
rows.translation: Windows 上或使用 HTTP 代理的聊天和 Cowork 任务，以及应用自身事件，均通过 OTLP/HTTP 导出到同一端点。只有采集器也在该端点接受 OTLP/HTTP 时，才选择 grpc。
OpenTelemetry 导出请求头

rows.original: Static collector headers — routing and tenant headers only. No credentials here; use Collector authentication or the headers helper script for tokens.
rows.translation: 采集器静态请求头，仅用于路由和租户信息。不含凭据；令牌请使用“采集器认证”或请求头助手脚本。
采集器认证
无（仅静态请求头）
复用推理凭据

rows.original: inference-credential sends the user’s inference bearer token to the collector as Authorization: Bearer.
rows.translation: inference-credential 将用户的推理 Bearer 令牌作为 Authorization: Bearer 发送到采集器。

rows.original: This sends the user’s inference token over plain http to another host. Use an https collector endpoint.
rows.translation: 这会通过普通 http 将用户的推理令牌发送到另一台主机。请使用 https 采集器端点。

rows.original: The configured inference credential is not sent as a bearer token, so telemetry will export without it. Use the headers helper script instead.
rows.translation: 当前推理凭据不是以 Bearer 令牌发送，因此遥测导出不会携带该凭据。请改用请求头助手脚本。
OpenTelemetry 请求头助手脚本

rows.original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a JSON object of collector headers. Merged over the static headers and Collector authentication; the helper wins.
rows.translation: 输出采集器请求头 JSON 对象的程序绝对路径。与静态请求头及“采集器认证”合并，冲突时以助手输出为准。
OpenTelemetry 资源属性
添加属性
导出跟踪

rows.original: Also export OpenTelemetry traces from Cowork tasks and Code sessions. Uses Claude Code’s session tracing.
rows.translation: 同时导出 Cowork 任务和 Code 会话的 OpenTelemetry 跟踪，使用 Claude Code 的会话跟踪功能。
遥测属性长度限制

rows.original: Maximum characters per content-bearing span attribute sent to the collector (256–32000). Default 4000. Read by the Microsoft 365 add-in.
rows.translation: 发送到采集器的含内容 span 属性的最大字符数（256–32000），默认 4000。由 Microsoft 365 加载项读取。

rows.original: Typically supplied by your bootstrap server when the gateway offers dictation.
rows.translation: 网关提供听写功能时，通常由引导服务器提供。
令牌上限统计窗口

rows.original: Tumbling window length for the token cap. Max 720 hours (30 days).
rows.translation: 令牌上限的固定统计窗口长度，最大 720 小时（30 天）。

rows.original: This choice would leave no surface on. Turn on Code first.
rows.translation: 此选择会关闭所有功能界面。请先开启 Code。

rows.original: “Code” is a product name — keep it untranslated in Latin script; translate the rest naturally.
“Cowork” is a product name — keep it untranslated in Latin script; translate the rest of the sentence naturally.
[no-translate] Product name; must remain exactly “Cowork” in every locale.

rows.translation: 允许 Code
允许 Chat
桌面主页

rows.original: Desktop home decides this while it is set.
rows.translation: 设置“桌面主页”后，由其决定此选项。

rows.original: “Desktop home” is the title of another setting on this page; use the same translation as that title.

rows.translation: 基础：Chat 与文件分析

rows.original: “Chat” is a product name — keep it untranslated in Latin script; translate the rest naturally.
“Chat” is a product name and “VM” abbreviates virtual machine — keep “Chat” untranslated in Latin script; translate the rest naturally.

rows.translation: 关闭：仅 Code

rows.original: Unifies Chat and Cowork into one home. When set, it replaces Allow Chat, Advanced file analysis, and Allow Cowork. Leave unset to keep those.
rows.translation: 将 Chat 和 Cowork 合并为一个主页。设置后替代“允许 Chat”“高级文件分析”和“允许 Cowork”。留空则保留这些选项。

rows.original: “Chat” and “Cowork” are product names — keep them untranslated in Latin script; translate the rest naturally.

rows.translation: 显示扩展目录

rows.original: The in-app catalogue of installable extensions. Hide to allow sideload only.
rows.translation: 应用内可安装扩展的目录。隐藏后仅允许旁加载。

rows.original: Security and compatibility fixes will not install automatically. Make sure IT has another distribution path.
rows.translation: 安全和兼容性修复将不会自动安装。请确保 IT 部门有其他分发渠道。
最高版本

rows.original: Third-party deployments only. Auto-update stops at this version (X.Y.Z) and devices on newer versions cannot open Claude. Delays security fixes; leave unset.
rows.translation: 仅适用于第三方部署。自动更新停止在此版本（X.Y.Z），已安装更新版本的设备无法打开 Claude。会延迟安全修复，建议留空。

rows.original: Devices on a newer version cannot open Claude, and security fixes in newer releases do not install, until you raise or remove this cap.
rows.translation: 在提高或取消此上限前，安装了更新版本的设备无法打开 Claude，新版本的安全修复也不会安装。
使用引导配置

rows.original: Fetch and apply the URL above at launch. Turn off to keep the URL saved but skip the fetch.
rows.translation: 启动时获取并应用上述 URL。关闭后保留已保存的 URL，但不获取配置。
引导配置服务器
引导 OIDC 参数
引导登录（OIDC）

rows.original: When set, the bootstrap request sends a Bearer token from a browser sign-in (authorization-code-with-PKCE).
rows.translation: 设置后，引导请求发送通过浏览器登录取得的 Bearer 令牌（authorization-code-with-PKCE）。
引导请求头

rows.original: HTTP headers sent on every bootstrap config fetch. Use this instead of embedding user:pass@ in the URL.
rows.translation: 每次获取引导配置时发送的 HTTP 请求头。请使用此项，避免在 URL 中嵌入 user:pass@。
引导请求头助手脚本

rows.original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a JSON object of bootstrap request headers. Merged over the static headers; the helper wins.
rows.translation: 输出引导请求头 JSON 对象的程序绝对路径。与静态请求头合并，冲突时以助手输出为准。

rows.original: Skip the per-user consent prompt for sign-in targets, inference endpoints, helper scripts, and connectors the bootstrap server delivers.
rows.translation: 跳过引导服务器提供的登录目标、推理端点、助手脚本及连接器的逐用户同意提示。

rows.original: Keep only your organization ID and restrictions on disk
rows.translation: 仅在磁盘保存组织 ID 和限制

rows.original: Don’t keep your organization’s name or any permissive setting on disk between launches; only your organization ID and the restrictions you turn on are kept.
rows.translation: 两次启动之间，不在磁盘保留组织名称或任何放宽权限的设置；仅保存组织 ID 和你开启的限制。

rows.original: Model ID exactly as the provider expects it. The first entry is the default model.
rows.translation: 提供商要求的精确模型 ID。第一项为默认模型。

rows.original: Adds a 1M-context variant of this model to the picker. Set only if the deployment accepts 1M-token context for it.
rows.translation: 在选择器中增加此模型的 1M 上下文变体。仅在部署支持该模型的 1M 令牌上下文时设置。

rows.original: When several models share a tier alias, marks this one as the model the alias resolves to. Otherwise the first listed wins.
rows.translation: 多个模型共用层级别名时，将此模型指定为别名解析的目标。否则以列表中第一项为准。

rows.original: Highest effort level offered for this model; higher levels are hidden and never requested by Claude Desktop. An unrecognized value caps the model at low.
rows.translation: 此模型可用的最高投入度。更高投入度会隐藏，Claude Desktop 也不会请求它们。无法识别的值会将模型投入度上限设为 low。
最低应用版本

rows.original: Oldest Claude Desktop version that can use this model, as three numbers like 2.2553.0. Older apps that read this setting grey the model out and ask to update.
rows.translation: 可使用此模型的最低 Claude Desktop 版本，以三个数字表示，如 2.2553.0。读取此设置的旧版应用会将模型置灰并提示更新。
Bedrock 控制平面
提供商
价格倍率

rows.original: Scales every estimated cost (0.85 = 85% of the price); between 0 and 1.
rows.translation: 按比例调整所有预估费用（0.85 表示价格的 85%），范围为 0 到 1。

rows.original: A model ID from the list above, or any other ID or alias your provider serves. A built-in Claude ID also covers its dated and provider forms.
rows.translation: 上述列表中的模型 ID，或提供商支持的其他 ID 或别名。内置 Claude ID 同时涵盖带日期和提供商格式的变体。
每百万输入令牌的美元价格。
每百万输出令牌的美元价格。

rows.original: USD per million prompt-cache read tokens.
rows.translation: 每百万提示缓存读取令牌的美元价格。

rows.original: USD per million prompt-cache write tokens (5-minute and 1-hour writes alike).
rows.translation: 每百万提示缓存写入令牌的美元价格（5 分钟及 1 小时写入均使用此价格）。
模型价格
添加价格

rows.original: Per-model rates replacing Anthropic list price in the Usage page’s estimate.
rows.translation: 在“用量”页面的费用估算中，以各模型费率替代 Anthropic 官方牌价。
模型目录镜像

rows.original: Connector favicons, artifact-preview and MCP Apps iframes, and the Linux spellcheck dictionary. Connector widgets fall back to text; spellcheck is off on Linux.
rows.translation: 连接器图标、Artifact 预览及 MCP Apps iframe，以及 Linux 拼写检查词典。连接器小组件会回退为文本，Linux 上的拼写检查将关闭。

rows.original: This disables connector icons, hosted artifact previews and MCP Apps widgets, and also turns spellcheck off on Linux. Artifacts still render locally, without CDN libraries; connectors that return MCP Apps show the text tool result instead of the widget.
rows.translation: 关闭连接器图标、托管的 Artifact 预览和 MCP Apps 小组件，同时关闭 Linux 拼写检查。Artifact 仍在本地渲染，但不使用 CDN 库；返回 MCP Apps 的连接器会显示文本工具结果，替代小组件。

rows.original: Report usage metrics to your Claude.ai organization
rows.translation: 向你的 Claude.ai 组织报告用量指标

rows.original: Set by the control plane from the organization’s Claude Code analytics setting; not editable here. Reports per-user token, cost and session counts (no content).
rows.translation: 由控制平面根据组织的 Claude Code 分析设置提供，无法在此编辑。报告每位用户的令牌数、费用和会话数，不包含内容。

rows.original: Endpoint is plain HTTP; auth credentials travel in cleartext.
rows.translation: 端点使用普通 HTTP，认证凭据会以明文传输。

rows.original: Shared bearer token: every org member authenticates as the same identity.
rows.translation: 共享 Bearer 令牌：所有组织成员均以同一身份认证。

rows.original: Start the pattern with a scheme such as https://, or *:// for any scheme: Claude Code compares a pattern with the server’s full address.
rows.translation: 模式须以 https:// 等协议开头，任意协议使用 *://：Claude Code 会将模式与服务器完整地址比较。
服务器 URL 模式
启用 Claude in Chrome

rows.original: Set by the control plane from the organization’s Claude in Chrome admin setting; not editable here. Lets sessions drive the user’s browser via the extension.
rows.translation: 由控制平面根据组织的 Claude in Chrome 管理设置提供，无法在此编辑。允许会话通过扩展操作用户的浏览器。

rows.original: Enable password managers in Claude in Chrome
rows.translation: 在 Claude in Chrome 中启用密码管理器

rows.original: Set by the control plane from the organization’s Password managers setting under Claude in Chrome; not editable here. Lets a password manager fill sign-ins.
rows.translation: 由控制平面根据 Claude in Chrome 下的组织密码管理器设置提供，无法在此编辑。允许密码管理器填写登录信息。

rows.original: URL pattern a plugin’s remote server must match, with * wildcards.
rows.translation: 插件远程服务器必须匹配的 URL 模式，支持 * 通配符。

rows.original: URL pattern of the remote servers to block, with * wildcards.
rows.translation: 要阻止的远程服务器的 URL 模式，支持 * 通配符。
禁止连接的插件 MCP 服务器

rows.original: Remote servers plugins may not connect, even if the allowed list admits them; in Code sessions, configuration-file servers too. Unset or empty blocks none.
rows.translation: 插件不可连接的远程服务器，即使允许列表包含它们也不例外；在 Code 会话中也适用于配置文件中的服务器。留空或未设置则不阻止任何服务器。
路径

rows.original: Absolute folder path. May start with ~ or one of the listed %VAR% tokens, expanded per user. Subfolders are included.
rows.translation: 文件夹的绝对路径，可使用 ~ 或列出的 %VAR% 标记开头，按用户展开。包含子文件夹。

rows.original: Approval policy per built-in tool or argument-scoped rule such as Bash(curl *). “ask” requires user approval before each matching call; “allow” is the default.
rows.translation: 各内置工具或参数限定规则（如 Bash(curl *)）的批准策略。“ask”要求每次匹配调用前由用户批准；“allow”为默认值。

rows.original: Offer Auto mode in the Code permission selector (on unless set to false); set to true to also offer it in Cowork. Claude decides which actions need approval.
rows.translation: 在 Code 权限选择器中提供自动模式（除非设为 false，否则默认开启）；设为 true 时，Cowork 也会提供该模式。Claude 决定哪些操作需要批准。
WebFetch 域名检查
使用 Claude Code 企业启动器

rows.original: Start Claude Code through the launcher in Claude Code’s managed settings (processWrapper) — this device’s, and an SSH host’s for SSH sessions. Off by default.
rows.translation: 通过 Claude Code 托管设置中的启动器（processWrapper）启动 Claude Code：本地会话使用此设备的启动器，SSH 会话使用 SSH 主机的启动器。默认关闭。

rows.original: Move app data off network shares
rows.translation: 将应用数据移出网络共享

rows.original: Store app data in local AppData on Windows devices where Roaming AppData is redirected to a network share, which Cowork tasks cannot run from.
rows.translation: 在 Windows 设备的 Roaming AppData 被重定向到网络共享时，将应用数据存入本地 AppData，因为 Cowork 任务无法从网络共享运行。
代理服务器
代理自动配置文件
EDR 集成包路径

rows.original: Path on the user’s computer to the signed package an endpoint security (EDR) vendor supplies for the Cowork workspace VM. Read from device management only.
rows.translation: 终端安全（EDR）厂商为 Cowork 工作区虚拟机提供的签名包在用户电脑上的路径。仅从设备管理读取。
EDR 集成厂商 ID

rows.original: The ID of the vendor that signed the package coworkEDRIntegration points to. Required with that key, or nothing is installed. Read from device management only.
rows.translation: 对 coworkEDRIntegration 指定的包进行签名的厂商 ID。须与该键同时提供，否则不安装任何内容。仅从设备管理读取。
安全虚拟机功能

rows.original: Runs tools inside an isolated VM instead of the host. Stronger isolation; slower file access and no host-process tools.
rows.translation: 在隔离虚拟机内而非宿主机运行工具。隔离更强，但文件访问较慢，且不支持宿主进程工具。

rows.original: The default host-native mode starts faster and works behind restricted networks. Shell commands run inside the VM; file tools run on the host with path-based access control. Enable this only if your security review requires the agent loop itself to run in the VM.
rows.translation: 默认的宿主原生模式启动更快，也可在受限网络后运行。Shell 命令在虚拟机内执行，文件工具在宿主机按路径控制访问。仅在安全审查要求智能体循环本身也在虚拟机内运行时开启此项。
指定组织

rows.original: Restricts login to specific org UUID(s). Single UUID string or JSON array.
rows.translation: 将登录限制为指定的组织 UUID。可填写单个 UUID 字符串或 JSON 数组。
仅允许一个账户

rows.original: Keep Claude Desktop signed in to one account at a time.
rows.translation: Claude Desktop 一次只能登录一个账户。

rows.original: Import earlier third-party sessions into this organization
rows.translation: 将此前的第三方会话导入此组织

rows.original: After sign-in to this organization, copies this computer’s earlier third-party sessions into the user’s local first-party profile, once per account and org.
rows.translation: 登录此组织后，将此电脑此前的第三方会话复制到用户的本地官方账户配置中。每个账户与组织组合仅执行一次。

rows.original: “disabled” forces browser-based Microsoft 365 sign-in; “required” fails sign-in when the OS broker is unavailable, so the refresh token stays broker-held.
rows.translation: “disabled”强制通过浏览器登录 Microsoft 365；“required”在操作系统认证代理不可用时使登录失败，确保刷新令牌始终由代理持有。
允许可选的客户端证书回退

rows.original: Turns the banner on. When false or unset, the other banner fields are ignored.
rows.translation: 启用横幅。设为 false 或留空时，其他横幅字段均被忽略。

rows.original: Single line, truncated on overflow. Maximum 200 characters.
rows.translation: 单行显示，超出后截断。最多 200 个字符。

rows.original: Default hex color value — DO NOT TRANSLATE
Six-digit hex (#RRGGBB). Applied exactly as configured; not theme-adapted.
rows.translation: 六位十六进制颜色（#RRGGBB），按配置原样应用，不随主题调整。
链接 URL

rows.original: Optional HTTPS URL. The banner text becomes a link when set.
rows.translation: 可选的 HTTPS URL。设置后，横幅文字会变成链接。

rows.original: Endpoint that returns a signed-in user’s Claude.ai conversation history. Only needed for importing directly from Claude.ai.
rows.translation: 返回已登录用户的 Claude.ai 对话历史的端点。仅直接从 Claude.ai 导入时需要。

rows.original: OAuth server users sign in to before importing directly from Claude.ai. Set with the export URL and client ID, or leave all three empty.
rows.translation: 用户直接从 Claude.ai 导入前登录的 OAuth 服务器。请与导出 URL 及客户端 ID 一起设置，或三项均留空。

rows.original: OAuth client ID this app presents to the OAuth issuer. Set with the export URL and OAuth issuer, or leave all three empty.
rows.translation: 此应用提交给 OAuth 签发方的客户端 ID。请与导出 URL 及 OAuth 签发方一起设置，或三项均留空。

rows.original: Prompt to import on a new chat or task. Off if unset. `show`: always; needs `enabled` or a sign-in import. `detect`: if `enabled` finds earlier Claude sessions.
rows.translation: 在新聊天或任务中提示导入。留空则关闭。`show`：始终提示，需要 `enabled` 或登录时导入。`detect`：仅在 `enabled` 找到此前 Claude 会话时提示。
导入提示跳过次数上限

rows.original: Skips allowed before the import prompt stays hidden: 1 to 10, 1 if unset. It returns 3 days after each skip except the last. An import hides it for good.
rows.translation: 导入提示永久隐藏前可跳过的次数：1 到 10，留空为 1。除最后一次外，每次跳过后 3 天会再次提示。完成导入后永久隐藏。
Microsoft Entra（Microsoft 365 加载项）
Entra 应用（客户端）ID

rows.original: Your organization’s Entra app registration for the Microsoft 365 add-in. Leave unset to use the add-in’s published application.
rows.translation: 组织为 Microsoft 365 加载项注册的 Entra 应用。留空则使用加载项已发布的应用。

rows.original: Microsoft cloud the add-in signs in against. Any cloud other than global requires your own app registration (client ID).
rows.translation: 加载项登录的 Microsoft 云环境。除 global 外的云环境均需要自行注册应用（客户端 ID）。

rows.original: This cloud has no published add-in application: set the client ID of your own registration.
rows.translation: 此云环境没有已发布的加载项应用：请设置自行注册应用的客户端 ID。

rows.original: Custom scopes are only requested through your own app registration: set the client ID.
rows.translation: 只有通过自行注册的应用才会请求自定义作用域：请设置客户端 ID。
委托作用域

rows.original: Delegated scopes the add-in requests (space- or comma-separated, all for one resource), e.g. your gateway’s api://…/.default. Requires your own client ID.
rows.translation: 加载项请求的委托作用域，以空格或逗号分隔，均须属于同一资源，如网关的 api://…/.default。需要自己的客户端 ID。
技能编写
回复反馈
加载项本身
文件上传
标识符类型
标签 GUID
标签名称

rows.original: Label GUIDs keep matching when a label is renamed. Label names must match exactly, including case.
rows.translation: 标签重命名后，标签 GUID 仍可匹配。标签名称必须完全一致，包括大小写。
等于

rows.original: Matches a file that has this label.
rows.translation: 匹配带有此标签的文件。
开头为

rows.original: Matches every label whose name starts with this text, for example all sublabels of one parent label.
rows.translation: 匹配名称以此文本开头的所有标签，例如某个父标签的全部子标签。
结尾为

rows.original: Matches every label whose name ends with this text.
rows.translation: 匹配名称以此文本结尾的所有标签。
任意标签
无标签
存在

rows.original: Any label matches every labeled file. No label matches unlabeled files and, for uploads, files that can’t have a label, such as images.
rows.translation: “任意标签”匹配所有已标记文件。“无标签”匹配未标记文件；上传时也匹配无法标记的文件，如图像。
适用对象
已打开文件

rows.original: Open file checks the document the add-in runs in. Uploaded file checks each file the user attaches. A statement checks only the type it names.
rows.translation: “已打开文件”检查加载项所在的文档。“已上传文件”检查用户附加的每个文件。每条策略仅检查其指定的文件类型。
标识符

rows.original: The statement applies to a file when any of these match its label.
rows.translation: 文件标签匹配其中任意一项时，此策略适用于该文件。

rows.original: A note for administrators. It has no effect.
rows.translation: 供管理员参考的备注，不影响行为。
效果

rows.original: Deny turns the actions off for matching files. Allow turns them off for every other file of that type. Deny wins when both match.
rows.translation: “拒绝”会关闭匹配文件的操作。“允许”会关闭该类型其他文件的操作。同时匹配时，以“拒绝”为准。

rows.original: The features this statement turns off. “The add-in itself” covers the whole add-in.
rows.translation: 此策略关闭的功能。“加载项本身”涵盖整个加载项。
资源

rows.original: The files this statement checks. A deny with no resource turns its actions off for every file.
rows.translation: 此策略检查的文件。未指定资源的拒绝策略会对所有文件关闭对应操作。
禁用的 Office 应用

rows.original: Host applications where the Claude add-in for Microsoft 365 is turned off.
rows.translation: 停用 Claude Microsoft 365 加载项的宿主应用。
禁用的加载项功能

rows.original: Add-in features turned off for everyone, on every file. “The add-in itself” turns the whole add-in off.
rows.translation: 对所有用户、所有文件关闭的加载项功能。“加载项本身”会关闭整个加载项。
文档访问策略
添加策略

rows.original: Allow or deny add-in features by the Microsoft Purview sensitivity label of the open or attached file.
rows.translation: 根据已打开或附加文件的 Microsoft Purview 敏感度标签，允许或拒绝加载项功能。
内置浏览器（站点安全检查）

rows.original: Default site policy in the built-in browser
rows.translation: 内置浏览器默认站点策略

rows.original: Allow all sites except blocked sites
rows.translation: 允许所有站点，已阻止站点除外

rows.original: Block all sites except allowed sites
rows.translation: 阻止所有站点，已允许站点除外

rows.original: Whether Claude may open sites in the built-in browser by default; the allowed or blocked list is the exception. Mirrors the Claude in Chrome site policy.
rows.translation: Claude 默认能否在内置浏览器中打开站点；允许或阻止列表作为例外。与 Claude in Chrome 站点策略对应。

rows.original: Allowed sites in the built-in browser
rows.translation: 内置浏览器允许的站点

rows.original: Sites Claude may open, read, and act on in the built-in browser when the default site policy is block. Users can still view other sites.
rows.translation: 默认策略为阻止时，Claude 可在内置浏览器中打开、读取和操作的站点。用户仍可查看其他站点。

rows.original: Blocked sites in the built-in browser
rows.translation: 内置浏览器阻止的站点

rows.original: Sites Claude may not open, read, or act on in the built-in browser when the default site policy is allow. Users can still view them.
rows.translation: 默认策略为允许时，Claude 不可在内置浏览器中打开、读取和操作的站点。用户仍可查看这些站点。

rows.original: Selects the inference backend. Setting this key activates third-party mode.
rows.translation: 选择推理后端。设置此键即启用第三方模式。

rows.original: Title of the Claude Desktop deployment settings page that holds what the desktop app may do on the device (tools, built-in browser, coding, files): an entry under Desktop 3P in the organization admin settings navigation, a section of the Desktop setup window, and a heading in the configuration reference. Noun. Use the same word as the organization-wide Capabilities settings page.

Hosts your network firewall must allow, derived from your current settings. This list is read-only and updates as you make changes. Traffic is HTTPS on port 443 unless an entry shows a port or starts with http://.
rows.translation: 网络防火墙必须放行的主机，根据当前设置生成。此列表只读，随设置变化自动更新。除非条目指定端口或以 http:// 开头，否则均使用 HTTPS 443 端口。

rows.original: This configuration is fetched from a bootstrap URL at launch. Fields it provides are locked below.
rows.translation: 启动时从引导 URL 获取此配置。其提供的字段在下方锁定。
空白
作用域（可选）
仅整个工具

rows.original: Path patterns go on {canonical}, which covers {tool}.
rows.translation: 路径模式应设置在 {canonical} 上，该规则涵盖 {tool}。

rows.original: Allow specific hosts with the egress host settings.
rows.translation: 通过出站主机设置允许指定主机。

rows.original: Replaces {count, plural, one {# scoped {tool} rule} other {# scoped {tool} rules}}
rows.translation: 替换{count, plural, one { # 条 {tool} 限定规则} other { # 条 {tool} 限定规则}}
策略
租户
已发现
正在测试…
已连接 · {latency}ms
未测试
连接成功 · {latency}ms
服务器
可用工具

rows.original: Server reachable but rejected the unauthenticated handshake. Choose an OAuth mode above to sign in, or add an Authorization header.
rows.translation: 服务器可访问，但拒绝了未经认证的握手。请在上方选择 OAuth 模式登录，或添加 Authorization 请求头。

rows.original: Your tenant may not be allowlisted yet — send the Client ID and Tenant ID above to your Anthropic representative (2-3 business days to activate).
rows.translation: 你的租户可能尚未加入允许列表，请将上方客户端 ID 和租户 ID 提供给 Anthropic 联系人（启用需 2–3 个工作日）。
测试失败
登录失败
清除登录状态
重新测试
测试此连接
{field} 色样
未知
移除条目

rows.original: Duplicate key — only the last value is kept.
rows.translation: 键重复，仅保留最后一个值。
第 {n} 项

rows.original: Value does not match the required format.
rows.translation: 值不符合所需格式。
{label} 配置
不允许任何项。
尚未设置。
组织规则：{rules}
工具名称

rows.original: MCP tool name as the server reports it.
rows.translation: 服务器报告的 MCP 工具名称。

rows.original: Approval state locked for this tool. Unlisted tools stay user-controlled.
rows.translation: 此工具的批准状态已锁定。未列出的工具仍由用户控制。
服务器名称

rows.original: Name of the plugin-delivered MCP server this policy applies to.
rows.translation: 此策略适用的插件提供的 MCP 服务器名称。

rows.original: Per-tool approval locks for this server.
rows.translation: 此服务器各工具的批准状态锁定设置。

rows.original: How the app connects: Streamable HTTP, legacy SSE, or a local command (stdio). policy-only connects to nothing; it only sets a plugin server’s tool policy.
rows.translation: 应用的连接方式：Streamable HTTP、旧版 SSE 或本地命令（stdio）。policy-only 不连接任何服务器，仅设置插件服务器的工具策略。

rows.original: Static headers sent on every request — routing and tenant headers only. No credentials here; use the headers helper script for tokens and rotating values.
rows.translation: 每次请求发送的静态请求头，仅用于路由和租户信息。不含凭据；令牌和轮换值请使用请求头助手脚本。

rows.original: How long the helper’s headers are reused before it runs again, in seconds. Defaults to 300.
rows.translation: 助手请求头在重新运行助手前的复用秒数，默认 300。

rows.original: Seconds before the TTL expires at which the helper re-runs mid-session. Defaults to 60. Keep it larger than the helper’s typical runtime.
rows.translation: 会话中在 TTL 到期前多少秒重新运行助手，默认 60。应大于助手通常的运行时间。

rows.original: Unique name for this server. Shown to users and used to key tool policy and sign-in state.
rows.translation: 此服务器的唯一名称，向用户显示，并用作工具策略及登录状态的索引。

rows.original: Lock the approval state for specific tools. Unlisted tools stay user-controlled.
rows.translation: 锁定指定工具的批准状态。未列出的工具仍由用户控制。
来自 IdP 应用注册

rows.original: OAuth client ID from your IdP app registration. Leave unset to auto-register (dynamic client registration) and only narrow scopes.
rows.translation: IdP 应用注册的 OAuth 客户端 ID。留空则自动注册客户端（动态客户端注册），且仅缩小作用域。

rows.original: Only for IdPs that require one (e.g. Box). Hosted config can store only a Google Desktop-app secret (GOCSPX-…); for other IdPs use the client secret helper.
rows.translation: 仅在 IdP 要求时提供（如 Box）。托管配置只能存放 Google 桌面应用密钥（GOCSPX-…）；其他 IdP 请使用客户端密钥助手。
绝对路径

rows.original: Executable that prints the client secret on stdout as a JSON object with a single clientSecret key; any other output is rejected. Overrides the inline value.
rows.translation: 在 stdout 输出仅包含 clientSecret 键的 JSON 对象的程序；任何其他输出均被拒绝。覆盖直接填写的值。

rows.original: Required when a client secret is configured. For a Google client use ["https://accounts.google.com"]; for mcp.box.com, ["https://api.box.com"].
rows.translation: 配置客户端密钥时必填。Google 客户端使用 ["https://accounts.google.com"]；mcp.box.com 使用 ["https://api.box.com"]。
授权 URL
令牌 URL

rows.original: Required for single-tenant Entra apps. Leave blank for multi-tenant or non-Microsoft IdPs.
rows.translation: 单租户 Entra 应用必填。多租户或非 Microsoft IdP 可留空。

rows.original: Space-separated scopes sent on the authorize request. Leave unset to use the scopes the server advertises. Required when Tenant ID is set.
rows.translation: 授权请求发送的作用域，以空格分隔。留空则使用服务器公布的作用域。设置租户 ID 时必填。

rows.original: Scope is required when Tenant ID is set.
rows.translation: 设置租户 ID 时，作用域为必填项。
回调主机
回调端口

rows.original: Only set if your IdP requires an exact-match redirect port. Entra accepts any.
rows.translation: 仅当 IdP 要求精确匹配重定向端口时设置。Entra 接受任意端口。

rows.original: Set by the Claude.ai control plane when it serves this configuration (the URL of Anthropic’s hosted client-metadata document); not authored.
rows.translation: 由 Claude.ai 控制平面提供此配置时设置（Anthropic 托管客户端元数据文档的 URL），无需自行填写。

rows.original: Required: the exact issuer URL(s) this server’s OAuth authorization server advertises. Anthropic signs the client identity only for the servers listed here.
rows.translation: 必填：此服务器的 OAuth 授权服务器公布的精确签发方 URL。Anthropic 仅为此处列出的服务器签署客户端身份。

rows.original: The exact issuer string(s) the server’s OAuth authorization server advertises in its metadata, as a JSON array — matched exactly, including path and any trailing slash. Required: Anthropic signs the client identity only for an authorization server listed here.
rows.translation: 服务器 OAuth 授权服务器在元数据中公布的精确签发方字符串，以 JSON 数组填写。须完全匹配，包括路径及末尾斜杠。必填：Anthropic 仅为此处列出的授权服务器签署客户端身份。
SSE（旧版）

rows.original: Choose a transport: Streamable HTTP or SSE for a remote server, or a local command (stdio).
rows.translation: 选择传输方式：远程服务器使用 Streamable HTTP 或 SSE，本地命令使用 stdio。

rows.original: HTTPS endpoint of the remote MCP server.
rows.translation: 远程 MCP 服务器的 HTTPS 端点。
自动注册（动态客户端注册）
使用自己的客户端
Anthropic 托管的客户端身份（需要 Claude.ai 登录）

rows.original: OAuth for a remote server: true to auto-register a client, a pre-registered client ID with tenant and scope, or mode “hosted” for an Anthropic-signed identity.
rows.translation: 远程服务器的 OAuth：true 表示自动注册客户端；也可提供预注册的客户端 ID、租户及作用域，或使用“hosted”模式获取 Anthropic 签署的身份。
请求头助手脚本

rows.original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a JSON object of HTTP headers on stdout. Merged over static headers; the helper wins on conflict.
rows.translation: 在 stdout 输出 HTTP 请求头 JSON 对象的程序绝对路径。与静态请求头合并，冲突时以助手输出为准。
助手缓存 TTL（秒）

rows.original: Arguments passed to the command, one per entry.
rows.translation: 传给命令的参数，每项一个。

rows.original: Environment variables set for the command.
rows.translation: 为命令设置的环境变量。

rows.original: Which bundled connector this entry turns on. Set instead of a transport; each built-in server has its own fields.
rows.translation: 此条目启用的内置连接器。使用此项替代传输方式；每个内置服务器均有自己的字段。
持续访问评估

rows.original: Request CAE-capable Microsoft Graph tokens: long-lived (up to about 28 hours) but revocable within minutes. Set “disabled” to keep standard one-hour tokens.
rows.translation: 请求支持 CAE 的 Microsoft Graph 令牌：有效期较长（最多约 28 小时），但可在数分钟内撤销。设为“disabled”则保留标准的一小时令牌。

rows.original: Runs search from the desktop, for inference providers without native web search. Supply the provider’s API key through the headers helper script below.
rows.translation: 在桌面执行搜索，供不支持原生网页搜索的推理提供商使用。通过下方请求头助手脚本提供其 API 密钥。
工具集

rows.original: HTTPS issuer with OIDC discovery. Set this, or set the authorization and token URLs instead.
rows.translation: 支持 OIDC 发现的 HTTPS 签发方。可设置此项，或改为设置授权 URL 和令牌 URL。

rows.original: OAuth client ID of the desktop app registration at your identity provider (public client, PKCE).
rows.translation: 桌面应用在身份提供商注册的 OAuth 客户端 ID（公共客户端，PKCE）。
签发方 URL

rows.original: HTTPS authorization endpoint. Used with the token URL when no issuer is set.
rows.translation: HTTPS 授权端点。未设置签发方时，与令牌 URL 配合使用。

rows.original: HTTPS token endpoint. Used with the authorization URL when no issuer is set.
rows.translation: HTTPS 令牌端点。未设置签发方时，与授权 URL 配合使用。
重定向端口
（临时）

rows.original: Fixed loopback port for the sign-in redirect. Leave unset to use a free port each time.
rows.translation: 登录重定向使用的固定回环端口。留空则每次使用空闲端口。
重定向主机

rows.original: Space-separated scopes. Defaults to openid profile email offline_access.
rows.translation: 以空格分隔的作用域。默认为 openid profile email offline_access。

rows.original: Space-separated scopes. Required in access-token mode: set the gateway or proxy API scope. offline_access is appended automatically unless disabled below.
rows.translation: 以空格分隔的作用域。访问令牌模式下必填，请设置网关或代理的 API 作用域。除非下方禁用，否则会自动附加 offline_access。
Bearer 令牌
ID 令牌（默认）
访问令牌
资源标识（RFC 8707）

rows.original: Access-token audience of the gateway or proxy: an https URL or an AD FS relying-party identifier, sent as the RFC 8707 resource. Leave unset for Entra ID.
rows.translation: 网关或代理的访问令牌受众：HTTPS URL 或 AD FS 信赖方标识符，作为 RFC 8707 resource 发送。Entra ID 可留空。
